items.note: First Job article (introduction, filed under ch. 1). One margin note beside the 'people of God' passage (printed 'Num. xxvi'?) could not be identified: bracketed note left. Work title taken from running head: 'Enarratio in librum Job'.

Introduction, filed under ch. 1. No margin note read for the obvious quotations Ezech 14:13-16 and Jas 5:10-11 (tagged anyway). A margin note 'Job xxiii' at the article's last line fits nothing: bracketed note.

Introduction (Gregory's preliminaries), filed under ch. 1. Doubtful OCR in Gregory's line on Atlas ('gigantec sis pieetur sudore', read as 'giganteis putetur sudore'). Jacob's margin reference badly printed (Gen 31:40 chosen, with a note); Josue's taken as Ecclus 46:1.

vv. 1-7, by two workers. The half sentence 'In justis vero perambulat Deus,' that runs on into part 2 was moved to the top of sources/t4/articles/job-004-part2.txt. Quotation from the Prayer of Manasses ('Peccavi super numerum arenae maris', cited by Denis as 2 Paralipomenon) left without a marker: not in the app's Douay-Rheims. Readings chosen: 'patriae' for printed 'patris'; 'Basil ... Deus inclusit' kept as printed (perhaps 'indulsit').

vv. 7-22, by two workers; Art. IV now complete. To check against the scan: 'Sit nomen Domini nominatum benedictum' (v. 21, kept as printed); the margin beside the Chaldeans (Jer/Joel/Hab, verse numbers guessed: Jer 6:23, Joel 2:3, Hab 1:6); the Exodus hardening references; 'Ps. xc' (taken as Ps 90:11); '* volitionem', the edition's correction in a Gregory quotation (English follows it).

By two workers. Margin numerals corrected by the text in many places (e.g. Rom 13:12, Is 42:1, Zach 3:8, 1 Thess 5:8, Mark 16:15, Is 53:10). Garbled OCR of the v. 4 lemma 'Et mittentes vocabant tres sorores suas' restored. Plato (Timaeus) quotation 'Ergone ... magnifice invitatus sum hodie' is a doubtful reading (note left). An illegible margin note near Acts 2:44 may be Acts 4:32 (note left). Quotations tagged without a margin note read: Jer 31:22, Acts 2:22/24, Ps 75:2, Is 49:18, Ps 108:4, John 17:20-21, John 6:37/44, Ps 134:6.

One worker. OCR gap after Mal 3:15 ('Iove Doo, et marere') read as the lemma 'Benedic Deo, et morere'. Kept printed 'a me tangi desine' (perhaps 'sine': note left). Margin misreadings resolved by the text: Mal 3:6 (read as 1 Mach), Jos 12:24, 3 Kings 21:13, 2 Kings 16:9, John 12:40, 2 Cor 4:4. Art. VIII (mystical sense of ch. 2). Margin note for the temptation in the desert misread ('Iusta. i'): Matt 4:1 assumed, with a note. Gregory's reading of Wis 12:15 (condemnas) differs from the Vulgate: note. 'manumque juvat exedentis' kept as printed (perhaps cædentis): note. Denis joins Rom 8:17 and 2 Tim 2:12 (si compatimur, et conregnabimus): tagged 2 Tim 2:12 with a note. Matt 11:27 / Matt 26:55 kept per margin (also in Luke 10:22, Mark 14:48).

By two workers. Margin numerals corrected by the text: Ps 40:9 (printed Ps xl, 9 read as 11:9), John 8:12, Is 61:1-2, Wis 2:24, Wis 14:24-26, 1 Cor 11:31, Ecclus 4:25, Jer 17:5. Prov 16:25 tagged where the margin gives Prov xiv, 12 (same words; Denis's wording matches 16:25): note left. Unreadable margin at Matt 13:17 (Denis's 'voluerunt' is Luke 10:24's wording): note left. Tagged without a margin note: Wis 2:24, John 14:2, Ps 89:11, Ps 31:1.

Albert the Great's exposition of ch. 3. First word damaged ('[yere'), read as Disputatio (note). Readings kept as printed, with notes: 'recordatio mentis' (perhaps mortis), 'Quæ ædificant'. Albert's text has 'Et non sit in recordatione viventis' in v. 4 (not in the Vulgate: note) and 'condemnat' for 'consumit' in Job 9:22. Tagged with no margin note read: Ps 55:4, Ps 119:5, Mark 9:18. Jer 20:15/17 combined by Denis (note).

Denis's objections to Albert on ch. 3. Margin beside 'nec ab ea cecidisse' read 'Job iii, 26': Job 1:22 assumed (note). Matt 5:11-12 mixed with Luke 6:22-23 ('Beati eritis ... Gaudete in illa hora'): markers for both. OCR 'ædio' read as tædio, 'ila' as illa. Tagged with margin note unread: Mark 9:18, 3 Kings 19:4, Job 42:10.

One worker. Garbled v. 18 lemma restored as 'non audierunt vocem exactoris'; 'rationale' read as 'naturale'. Tagged without margin note: Matt 26:24, Is 14:4.

Opening word read as 'Quantum capere queo' (OCR 'Qi'). Footnote variant 'tenebant' for printed 'timebant' followed in the English, with a note. Margin note beside 'Littera occidit' unreadable; tagged 2 Cor 3:6.

Literal exposition of ch. 4, by two workers (split at v. 13). Garbled lemma of v. 19 restored from the Vulgate ('Quanto magis hi qui habitant domos luteas'); 'Victor noster' read as Fictor (Is 64:8); 'profecnnt ultionem' read as proferunt (uncertain). Mystical exposition of ch. 5, by one worker. Garbled lemmata of v. 23 rebuilt from the sense ('Sed cum lapidibus regionum pactum tuum erit'; place of 'tibi' in 23b uncertain). Readings chosen: ridebis (OCR videbis, v. 22), de morte animi, grandi potentia, præinclyta, Judææ. Acts 4:14 verse number unreadable (note); Acts 17:11 note (Bereans, not Thessalonians). Many margin numerals unreadable and set from the text: check against the scan.

Literal exposition of ch. 6, by one worker. v. 23 lemma unreadable in the OCR, rebuilt from the Vulgate ('Vel, Liberate me de manu hostis, et de manu robustorum eruite me?'): check against the scan. Margin numerals corrected (notes): Prov 24:16, Ecclus 18:27, John 7:5, 2 Tim 2:14, Jas 3:2, Ps 87:8/17. v. 28 'implete*' with margin variant 'explete' (note). One worker. Lemma 6:4 restored from badly garbled OCR ('Quarum indignatio ebibit spiritum meum'). Kept as printed: 'ex timore filialiter timent' (perhaps 'ex amore'). 'Sapiens non murmurabit correptus' marked Ecclus 10:28 with a note (margin unread).

One worker. v. 13 lemma badly garbled, reconstructed as 'Sic viæ … omnium qui obliviscuntur Deum' (check against scan). vv. 20–21: printed 'non desinit' kept with a note (sense needs 'non sinit'). One worker. Damaged reading 'gratiarumque A lore' (v. 11) read as 'flore', with a note (could be 'calore'). Unread margin beside 'Quia Dominus amat judicium' marked Ps 36:28. Denis joins Is 65:24 and Is 58:9: two markers and a note.

Published with gaps; needs-scan for PDF 448 (four lines lost, vv. 7–9) and PDF 452 (one word, "audire […] meruit"). Two workers (split at v. 13).
